'''Operation: Shining Man''' was a covert operation carried out by the [[Star Cabal]] that saw their operative [[Albathius]] infiltrate the culture of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and turn them against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Albathius became a legendary figure known as the Shining Man to the Voss.
